title: Letter to John Hewitt, 14 June 1835
source_note: [Kirtland high council (including JS)], Letter, Kirtland Township, Geauga Co., OH, to John Hewitt, Fairport, Geauga Co, OH, 14 June 1835. Featured version copied [not before 25 Feb. 1836] in Minute Book 1, p. 92; handwriting of Warren Cowdery; CHL. For more complete source information, see the source note for Minute Book 1.
